Q: Fill the remainder of a string with blank spaces A:

The function you are looking for is str_pad.

http://php.net/manual/function.str-pad.php

$str = 'ABCDEFGHI';
$longstr = str_pad($str, 32);

The default pad string already is blank spaces.

As your maximum length should be 32 and str_pad won't take any action when the string is longer than 32 characters you might want to shorten it down using substr then:

http://php.net/manual/function.substr.php

$result = substr($longstr, 0, 32);

This again won't take any action if your string is exactly 32 characters long, so you always end up with a 32 characters string in $result now.

Q: Getting digital signature Error "Error Encountered while BER decoding" using TCPDF A:

Had the same issue and solved it by replacing:

$certificatePath = 'file:///home/tcpdf.crt';

Note the extra '/' in the path

Q: Error 127 - recipe for target failed - When compiling Google NaCl examples from Pepper 19? A:

tl;dr: your cygwin may be buggy and give this return code to all batch file. My does this. My cygwin version:

$ uname -srv
CYGWIN_NT-6.1-WOW64 1.7.17(0.262/5/3) 2012-10-19 14:39

From your comment, I see something called "make.bat":

mparadis@A-082-MPARADI-0 ~/pepper_19/examples/dlopen
$ ls dlopen.cc dlopen.html eightball.cc eightball.h make.bat Makefile

You can test your cygwin with this little bash script, too..

#!/bin/bash
echo echo foo %errorlevel% bar >temp.bat
./temp.bat
if [ $? -eq 127 ]; then echo "bug"; fi

If your make recipe for that target uses make.bat, and you have this bug, then this cygwin bug is causing the Error 127

Q: Adobe Flash CS3 Profesional - missing DirectShow 9 and QuickTime 7 A:

1] Download and install the latest DirectX.

2] Confirm the version, enter "dxdiag" in run prompt. Diagnostic Tool will open. Under "Display 1" (and "Display 2" if you have dual monitor) tab, check that "Direct Draw acceleration" and "Direct Draw 3D" is enabled. You can also run some tests. In notes box see potential errors.

3] Download and install QuickTime or if you don't like bloat - QuickTime Alternative

4] Restart and enjoy working Adobe Flash Encoder.

(tested on WIN XP Pro)

Q: Why does .NET System.IO.File use Create/Open instead of a constructor? A:

The File class was a late addition to the .NET Framework version 1.0. Added after Microsoft conducted a usability study. They invited programmers that never used .NET before and asked them to write code that used the FileStream and StreamWriter classes. The ones that have a constructor. The success rate was zero.

So they came up with File, it has a bunch of static helper methods that create/open files. Think of them as factory methods. And no, you don't create a File. You use it. Check your favorite C# programming language book about static class.

Q: How to pass a scopedvalue to a child thread? A:

A scoped value is automatically available only within the thread where it is created. To use it in a child thread, create the child with a structured concurrency mechanism that inherits the scoped value, or explicitly bind the value in the child thread.
